workload.name: Example Workload
workload.purpose: Provide a secure internal application platform.

inScope: Deploy workload resources into a new spoke virtual network.
Integrate with existing central platform services.
outOfScope: Modification of the existing hub virtual network.
Modification of the central Azure Firewall policy.
successCriteria: The workload is reachable through approved private connectivity.
All required diagnostics are sent to the central workspace.

azureEstate.resourceGroupStrategy: Separate resource groups by lifecycle and responsibility.
dataResidencyRequirements: Workload data must remain within the European Union.

network.egressPath: Central Azure Firewall in the hub.

privateConnectivity.onPremisesDnsIntegration: Conditional forwarding through Azure Private DNS Resolver.
permittedDnsChanges: Create a private DNS zone group on a workload-owned private endpoint.

managedIdentities: User-assigned managed identity for the workload

policyRequirements: Comply with inherited landing-zone Azure Policy assignments.
encryptionRequirements: Encryption at rest using platform-managed keys.
TLS 1.2 or later for data in transit.
secretManagementRequirements: Applications retrieve secrets through managed identity.
defenderRequirements: Use the applicable subscription-level Defender for Cloud plans.
publicExposure: Public network access is prohibited for data services.

governance.namingConvention: Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework naming convention.
governance.resourceOwnershipModel: Workload resources are owned by the Workload Team; shared resources are owned by the Platform Team.
finOpsRequirements: Produce an estimated monthly cost before production deployment.
governance.exceptionProcess: Exceptions require approval from the Platform Team and Security Team.

backupRequirements: Back up persistent workload data according to the organizational retention policy.
maintenanceRequirements: Production maintenance requires an approved change.
patchManagementRequirements: Use the centrally approved patch-management process.

diagnosticSettings: Send supported platform logs and metrics to the central workspace.
observability.retentionRequirements: Retain operational logs according to the central workspace policy.

delivery.rollbackStrategy: Use forward-fix for infrastructure definitions and restore data from approved backups when required.
delivery.secretInjectionStrategy: Use workload identity federation and Key Vault references without pipeline secrets.

prohibitedChanges: Do not modify the hub virtual network address space.
Do not modify the central Azure Firewall policy.
Do not create or modify centrally owned Private DNS zones.

dependencies.description: The Platform Team must create or approve hub-to-spoke peering.

decisions.statement: The workload will use the existing hub-and-spoke topology.
decisions.rationale: The target subscription is part of the existing enterprise landing zone.

readiness.rationale: All material workload, platform, ownership, security, and delivery requirements have been confirmed.
